root_cause.text: Iris_release_internal_buffers() dereferences the buffer pointer after calling session_release_buf(), which may free the buffer when BUF_ATTR_PENDING_RELEASE is not set beforehand, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `buffer->attr |= BUF_ATTR_PENDING_RELEASE` before the call to `session_release_buf()` and reverts it only on failure, while the commit explicitly states that `session_release_buf()` may free the buffer and the caller continued to access `buffer` after the call.
